# Ching Ching

> Ching Ching (on the App Store as "Ching Ching Portfolio") is a free portfolio
> tracker for PulseChain and Ethereum wallets on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch,
> on the App Store since 2022. Add wallets by address, ENS name or .pls name to
> see token holdings with live prices, HEX stakes with T-Share details, NFTs,
> liquidity pool positions, chain stats and gas prices, plus home screen
> widgets. Completely free, with no subscription. No accounts or sign-ups:
> wallet addresses and settings stay on the device, and the app has no
> analytics, crash reporting or advertising SDKs. It reads public blockchain
> data, and a few requests go to small servers run for the app, as the privacy
> policy describes. chingching.xyz also has a read-only web portfolio viewer, an
> LP Yield page for claimable V3 LP fees, and free browser games in the Arcade.
> Ching Ching shows data only: it gives no financial advice and makes no price
> predictions.

## Key pages
- Web portfolio viewer (any PulseChain or Ethereum wallet, read-only): https://chingching.xyz/

- Privacy policy: https://chingching.xyz/privacy/

- In Too Deep (swim the real PLS chart): https://chingching.xyz/in-too-deep/

- PulseChain Oceanomics: https://chingching.xyz/oceanomics/
- Pulse Cannon (defend the tokens): https://chingching.xyz/pulse-cannon/
- Pump & Jump (ride the real PLS chart): https://chingching.xyz/pump-and-jump/

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/ching-ching/id1622965914
